name: 2.6.10 - Open RO closed for new jobs
notes: A new order from the phone (Job Card, SUBMIT TO COSTAR) closes a Repair Order left open in the selected COSTAR first, as the phone's Repair Orders do since 2.6.7: once nobody has used the PC for 3 s, never one waiting for review (a phone job's, an online order's, an eBay order's) or one COSTAR is asking something on. Includes 2.6.9. Update the RDP helper (the desk PC may update too).
